title: 302nd AW Deployers Return Home -Mar 7, 2025
credit: U.S. Air Force Reserve video (302nd Airlift Wing)
description: 302nd Airlift Wing deployers return home to Peterson Space Force Base, Colo., March 7, 2025. Air Force Reservists from the 302 Operations Group and Maintenance Group were deployed to Africa for several months in support of operations across the theater.
